step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identifies entities from the World Model and transcript: Clinic (ThirdParty), Kafka (ThirdParty), Kinesis Data Streams, Lambda 1, Kinesis Data Firehose, Glue, Data Center (OnPremDC), S3, Kinesis Data Analytics, Lambda 2, SageMaker, Elasticsearch (OpenSearch), and User (UserCompanyAnalyst).
2. Establishes flows:
   - Flow 0: Near-real-time streaming pipeline from dialysis devices in Clinic -> Kafka -> Kinesis Data Streams -> Lambda 1 -> Kinesis Data Analytics -> Lambda 2 -> SageMaker (for inference) -> Lambda 2 -> Elasticsearch -> User.
   - Flow 1: Data lake storage pipeline from Lambda 1 -> Kinesis Data Firehose -> S3.
   - Flow 2: Static clinical feature ingestion from Data Center (EDW) -> Glue -> S3 -> Kinesis Data Analytics.
3. Validates service types against allowed lists and maps Elasticsearch to OpenSearch, Data Center to OnPremDC, and clinical users to UserCompanyAnalyst.

graph.name: Fresenius Medical Care Intradialytic Hypotension Prediction Architecture
graph.notes: This architecture processes real-time telemetry from dialysis machines alongside static clinical data from an enterprise data warehouse to predict intradialytic hypotension incidents using SageMaker and visualize risk scores in Elasticsearch/Kibana.

nodes.name: Clinic
nodes.notes: Houses dialysis devices generating patient telemetry every 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Kafka
nodes.notes: Kafka topics staging real-time dialysis machine payloads.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Streams
nodes.notes: Ingests data from Kafka via Kinesis Kafka Connector.

nodes.name: Lambda 1
nodes.notes: Processes Kinesis data streams and routes payloads to analytics and data lake.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
nodes.notes: Buffers dynamic stream payloads for ingestion into S3 big data lake.

nodes.name: Data Center
nodes.notes: Hosts enterprise data warehouse containing static clinical datasets.

nodes.name: Glue
nodes.notes: Extracts clinical datasets from EDW, builds static features, and loads to S3.

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: Big data lake storage for analytics, machine learning, and static clinical features.

nodes.name: Kinesis Data Analytics
nodes.notes: Combines dynamic machine data and static clinical data to build full ML features in near real time.

nodes.name: Lambda 2
nodes.notes: Receives compiled feature lists, invokes SageMaker for inference, and writes prediction results to Elasticsearch.

nodes.name: SageMaker
nodes.notes: Hosts predictive ML model for intradialytic hypotension risk scoring.

nodes.name: Elasticsearch
nodes.notes: Stores inference results and powers Kibana dashboards.

nodes.name: Clinical User
nodes.notes: Monitors patient risk probabilities near real time via Kibana.
